claim: maintenance.api_database_optimize closes the g-scoped DB connection, breaking later same-request queries
rationale: FALSE POSITIVE: get_db() (services/database.py:78) ALWAYS opens a fresh sqlite3 connection — it never returns the flask.g-cached connection (that is get_request_db()). api_database_optimize (routes/maintenance.py:166) runs VACUUM/ANALYZE on that dedicated fresh connection and closes only it; g.db is untouched. Verified 2026-06-05. The Lane 9 reviewer assumed get_db()==g.db, which is not the codebase's contract.
